CMOS binary capacitive charge-redistribution DAC
.include "circuit.spice"
.include "models.spice"
VDD vdd 0 3.3
V0 d0 0 PULSE(0 3.3 100n 100p 100p 99.9n 200n)
V1 d1 0 PULSE(0 3.3 200n 100p 100p 199.9n 400n)
V2 d2 0 PULSE(0 3.3 400n 100p 100p 399.9n 800n)
VR reset 0 PWL(0 3.3 15n 3.3 15.1n 0 800n 0)
XDUT vdd 0 d0 d1 d2 reset out astra_056_cmos_capacitive_charge_dac
.temp 27
.options method=gear reltol=1e-5
* @spec code0 range -0.025 0.025 unit=V
* @spec code1 range 0.38749999999999996 0.4375 unit=V
* @spec code2 range 0.7999999999999999 0.85 unit=V
* @spec code3 range 1.2125 1.2624999999999997 unit=V
* @spec code4 range 1.625 1.6749999999999998 unit=V
* @spec code5 range 2.0375 2.0875 unit=V
* @spec code6 range 2.4499999999999997 2.4999999999999996 unit=V
* @spec code7 range 2.8625 2.9124999999999996 unit=V
.control
set filetype=ascii
tran 100p 800n
meas tran code0 FIND v(out) AT=70n
meas tran code1 FIND v(out) AT=170n
meas tran code2 FIND v(out) AT=270n
meas tran code3 FIND v(out) AT=370n
meas tran code4 FIND v(out) AT=470n
meas tran code5 FIND v(out) AT=570n
meas tran code6 FIND v(out) AT=670n
meas tran code7 FIND v(out) AT=770n
write out.raw v(out) v(d0) v(d1) v(d2) v(reset)
quit
.endc
.end
